metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting air and somehow 2 enemies said goodbye? Valorant logic is wild!
metadata.description:
Me: clicking like I’m allergic to aiming
Enemies: probably uninstalling in confusion
Valorant: handing out 2 kills like free candy
If your aim’s a mystery, you feel me!

Tap if your aim’s a complete mess but kills keep dropping!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
